Additionally, she is able to create small black holes, distort dimensions, and fire a destructive energy wave. Gardevoir's power reaches its peak when protecting its Trainer, whom it will protect with its life. This Pokémon typically inhabits urban areas, but has occasionally been sighted in snowy regions.
